$comment: Canonical shape of Shared/data's offline Today datasets. The files are generated in Shared and physically copied into all three apps. The selected calendar controls both its feast file and readingsFile. Missing data hides the corresponding row; it never falls back to another rite. See ../ARCHITECTURE.markdown#offline-today-data-shareddata.

default.description: Calendar id used when feastCalendarId is absent or unknown.

file.description: Basename of this calendar's feast JSON.

readingsFile.description: Basename of this calendar's citation JSON. LPJ and General Roman intentionally share readings-roman. Provisional calendars without supplied readings omit this field and never borrow another calendar’s readings.

paschaVariants.description: Optional matched feast and reading tables. The easternPaschaStyle preference selects both together; absent/unknown values use defaultPaschaStyle.

liturgicalYearStart.description: Civil Gregorian calendar metadata for the generated years. New-style UGCC uses September 1; old-style Julian September 1 falls on September 14 in 2026–2027.

calendarRegistry.legacyMigration: Persisted roman-he maps to roman; roman-he is not a selectable calendar and has no dataset.

feastDataset.files: Feast files named by CalendarDefinition.file and each paschaVariants entry
feastDataset.importedMetadata: Optional importedSourceMetadata fields identify dated annual editions, exact coverage and reproducible source snapshots. Missing dates never borrow another calendar.

sourceUrl.description: Primary document from which this dated observance was imported.

sourceOnlyLanguages.description: Explicitly uncovered title languages that use the English heading. Imported order calendars require six non-Hebrew editorial captions; Hebrew stays absent until an exact credited church-source identity is available. The printed heading remains in sourceTitleByLanguage.

readingSourceReview.description: Reason an ambiguous printed appointment is quarantined instead of corrected by inference or borrowed from another calendar.

title.description: Semicolon-separated observances for the date. Syriac rows keep Evangelizo SYE saint names and spelling, supplemented with observances from SYA; a ferial main title never hides its saints. A matching English saint name takes precedence over the main liturgy's alternate spelling.

observances.description: Optional ordered calendar components: title/identity plus titleByLanguage, sourceTitleByLanguage and optional descriptionByLanguage/descriptionSourceByLanguage/descriptionCreditByLanguage maps. Native feast headings consume assembled day titles; saint disclosures consume exact-interface-language component biographies with no foreign fallback. Expanded descriptions omit a heading identical to an already displayed parent feast title after Hebrew display-pointing and whitespace normalization, preserving distinct saint headings and all source text. The supplied Hebrew 2026 Urtotho reference joins exact source UID/date/identity, applies only to Syriac, and never changes calendar dates or ranks.

rank.description: Canonical rank used by calendar logic and title prominence. Localize its display caption using the Today language without changing this value.

titleByLanguage.description: Localized metadata in Hebrew, Arabic, Russian, Filipino, French, Italian and Ukrainian. Sourced identities take precedence over editorial metadata; reviewed aliases never change dates, ranks or observances. Syriac Arabic captions preserve actual SYA component labels, with reviewed translations for English-only saints. Syriac generation requires every localized component and fails before writing when one is missing; English copied into a locale is not a translation. Hebrew Pentecost uses שבועות.

readingsDataset.importedMetadata: Optional importedSourceMetadata fields use the same source edition and coverage as the selected feast calendar.

sourcePage.description: One-based source PDF page for the appointed passages.

readings.description: Ordered appointed citations only; no Scripture text.

ReadingCitation.constraints: Every numeric range uses an en dash. Hebrew short/full values use book + gematria chapter + Arabic verse numbers with no colon. Arabic full citations use LRI/PDI around the numeric reference to preserve range order in RTL.

short.description: Compact home form, normally book plus chapter.

full.description: Complete book/chapter/verse citation shown after expansion. A source that appoints whole Psalms may omit verse bounds, including a chapter span; generators preserve that printed choice.

sourceText.description: Exact printed citation span when an imported source uses distinct abbreviations or punctuation; provenance only.

sourceGroup.description: Source wording for the Mass, additional reading or alternative choice this citation belongs to. Readers show a heading when this value changes; missing values preserve the ordinary flat list.

hebrew.description: Legacy full Hebrew citation accepted by readers; new generators write fullByLanguage.he.

sources.readings-roman: Evangelizo publication edition HE (Novus Ordo; includes sourced Hebrew citation maps)
sources.readings-roman1962: Missale Meum public proper API (Vetus Ordo)
sources.readings-ugcc: UGCC Patriarchal Liturgical Commission official 2026 calendar; Ukraine new-style fixed feasts and Julian Pascha
sources.readings-ugcc-gregorian: Royal Doors public UGCC fully Gregorian calendar
sources.readings-ugcc-julian: Empty pending a separately verified old-style Byzantine lectionary; existing new-style appointments are never shifted or borrowed.
sources.readings-stjames: Saint James Vicariate supplied bilingual 2026–2027 calendar; its Great Advent and Vicariate-wide Mass appointments, including printed additional/alternative groups
sources.readings-franciscan-conventual-italy: Province of Saint Anthony of Padua, OFM Conventual, Italy: annual Advent2025–Advent2026 Ordo. Only explicit printed citations; undeclared Seraphic Missal and ferial references stay absent.
sources.readings-augustinian-discalced: Order of Discalced Augustinians general 2026 Ordo. First printed general/day Mass; national variants excluded.

runtimeContext.description: Derived from the actual loaded readingsFile basename after calendar and Pascha resolution, and frozen into each returned citation at the provider request boundary. This field is transient, not read from authored/localized citation JSON. A later settings change cannot reinterpret an already pending passage request. LPJ and Roman capture roman; fully Gregorian UGCC captures ugcc-gregorian.

languagePreference.source: effective App Language from interfaceLanguageCode or the system preference
languagePreference.description: Today follows App Language, independently of global and per-prayer language choices. There is no separate Today language picker. Previously persisted todayLanguageCode is ignored. iw and fil normalize to he and tl; Arabic and Hebrew apply RTL to the complete Today stack, including expanded citations.

importedSourceMetadata.sourceSha256: SHA-256 of the imported source PDF
importedSourceMetadata.description: Optional fields on imported feast and reading dataset roots. Coverage is edition-specific; the importer verifies dates, weekdays and complete source row counts. Personal anniversaries and necrologies are excluded. Dates, rank precedence and appointments remain those of the published annual Ordo. Editorial interface captions retain complete raw source titles on observances.

fields.title: Published English title
fields.sourceByLanguage: map<string,URL> for the published edition or source translated; interpret with translationCreditByLanguage

intentionDataset.fallback: Missing language uses published English; missing month hides the row. Hebrew and Ukrainian translations are credited to Prosary, not presented as official Vatican editions.

torahDataset.source: Hebcal.com, CC BY 4.0, Eretz Israel only (i=on)
torahDataset.selection: The selected civil day maps to the next Saturday, including Saturday itself. A holiday Torah service replaces the weekly portion; diaspora schedules are never requested. Only books of the Torah are included, without haftarah or festival megillot.
torahDataset.language: Source Hebrew, French, Russian and Ukrainian proper names where supplied by Hebcal; source transliterations for remaining locales, with localized interface captions and citation book names.

dateNavigation.state: Local civil selected date, initially today; independent of prayer progress and prayer-day computation.
dateNavigation.controls: Previous day arrow, centered formatted-date button, next day arrow. Date button opens a native calendar with a Today action inside its popup.
dateNavigation.supplementalDayRow: Hidden on every Sunday. On weekdays, lpj/roman use the modern Roman seasonal day; roman1962 and all Eastern calendars show the localized civil day and month, never Ordinary Time.
dateNavigation.bounds: Respect each native picker’s supported civil-date range; Android uses 1900–2100. Missing date or month data hides only its corresponding row.

missionProvisionalDataset.readingsSource: Evangelizo publication edition SYE, shared with the Syriac Catholic calendar. Reading coverage is independent of the supplied provisional feast dates; absent dates remain unavailable.
missionProvisionalDataset.categories: Only explicit source CATEGORIES; initial ICS has none.
missionProvisionalDataset.sourceRecurrence: Retained for provenance; yearly RRULE is never expanded for movable feasts.
missionProvisionalDataset.sections: CalendarTextSection[] with exact source sections; reflectionByLanguage exact-language only.
missionProvisionalDataset.spelling: Reviewed display correction map retains exact sourceTitleByLanguage/sourceDescriptionByLanguage and UID.
